name: pi-commands
description: All pi (pi-coding-agent) prompt-templates imported as ZCode slash-commands. Content verbatim. ZCode derives the command name from the filename, so the 'name:' frontmatter key (when present) is redundant but harmless — ZCode ignores it. v0.2.0 adds a UserPromptSubmit hook that re-injects the command index on every prompt, fixing the runtime disappearance bug where long sessions drop the command listing via tail-window truncation.
author: bhd
